proposals.tactic:
revert h₀
induction n with
| zero =>
  intro hn
  omega
| succ k ih =>
  intro hn
  by_cases hk : 3 ≤ k
  · have hPow : k ^ (k - 1) ≤ k.succ ^ (k - 1) := by
      first
      | exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ k) _
      | gcongr <;> exact Nat.le_succ k
    calc
      k.succ.factorial = k.succ * k.factorial := Nat.factorial_succ k
      _ < k.succ * k.succ ^ (k - 1) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (lt_of_lt_of_le (ih hk) hPow) (Nat.zero_lt_succ k)
      _ = k.succ ^ (k - 1 + 1) := (pow_succ' _ _).symm
      _ = k.succ ^ (k.succ - 1) := congrArg (fun e : Nat => k.succ ^ e) (by omega)
  · have he : k = 2 := by omega
    subst k
    decide

proposals.name: factorial_bound
proposals.type: ∀ k m : Nat, k + 2 ≤ m → (k + 2).factorial ≤ 2 * m ^ k

proposals.tactic:
have factorial_bound : ∀ k m : Nat, k + 2 ≤ m → (k + 2).factorial ≤ 2 * m ^ k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro m hm
    change (2 : Nat).factorial ≤ 2 * m ^ 0
    simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using (show (2 : Nat).factorial ≤ 2 by decide)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro m hm
    have hk : k + 2 ≤ m := by omega
    calc
      (k.succ + 2).factorial = (k.succ + 2) * (k + 2).factorial := Nat.factorial_succ (k + 2)
      _ ≤ m * (2 * m ^ k) := Nat.mul_le_mul hm (ih m hk)
      _ = 2 * m ^ k.succ := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        ac_rfl
have hn : n - 2 + 2 = n := by omega
have hb := factorial_bound (n - 2) n (by omega)
rw [hn] at hb
have hp : 0 < n := by omega
calc
  n.factorial ≤ 2 * n ^ (n - 2) := hb
  _ < n * n ^ (n - 2) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by omega) (pow_pos hp _)
  _ = n ^ (n - 2 + 1) := (pow_succ' _ _).symm
  _ = n ^ (n - 1) := congrArg (fun e : Nat => n ^ e) (by omega)
